integrity: The lower bound is proved by exact extremal square-sum arguments and the equality layer is classified analytically. A separate standard-library verifier independently generates every positive five-part partition through common total 13 in two ways, checks all pairwise reversals exactly, and replays two infinite reversal families.
scientific_limitations: The sharp minimum is a rational common-scale statement for the traditional four-firm concentration ratio and HHI. It does not imply that market shares have a natural unit size, does not cover other concentration ratios, and does not turn either structural statistic into a complete antitrust or competition assessment.
title: Five firms and thirteen market units are the first strict CR4–HHI reversal
